task_name: Panel and relationship list polish from the isolated live preview
description: P1: the Module fact shows the module path (id without 'module:') as a link-style button (min 24 px high) that calls onSelect(node.module). P2: list h4 headings use RELATIONSHIP_KIND_LABELS, node-kind badges (rows and header) use NODE_KIND_LABELS, second-step rows name the kind as the lowercased label; labels.ts created with exactly the dispatched content (it did not exist). P3: an adjacent row is a flex line: title (.truncate, max 60%), kind badge, path (.truncate, flex 1, min 4ch), origin tags; the button keeps title=<full path>; the li wraps only opened evidence to a full-width line. P4: evidence sits behind a toggle button (aria-expanded, aria-controls, closed by default) at the row end, labelled '<count> imports' when the edge has a count, else 'N example(s)'; opening shows at most two lines plus 'and N more'. An evidence item equal to either end's path is dropped, and when one is present the origin words beside it (lowercase-hyphen tokens like 'related-code', 'key-files', 'frontmatter') become .tag chips on the row; a row whose evidence was only that has no toggle. A count with no remaining lines shows as muted text. P5: the second-step group is a <details> closed by default whose summary holds the h3 'Second step <count>'; its rows use the same evidence toggle and origin tags. P6: the counts fact is labelled 'Relationships'; the fact key column is 14ch so it fits and follows the text scale.

assumptions: An evidence item counts as repeating the path when it equals the path of either end of the edge (the neighbour or the root), because from the file's side a describes edge repeats the root's path, not the wiki page's.
An origin word is a lowercase word or hyphenated words with no slash, colon or space; such words become tags only when the evidence also repeats a path, otherwise they stay example lines.

behavior_changes.description: The evidence disclosure is a small toggle button at the end of the row (chevron + '7 imports' or 'N examples') that opens the lines on a full-width line below, rather than a <details> under each row, so a closed row stays one line.
alternatives: a <details> element under every row (adds a summary line per row)

behavior_changes.description: Second-step rows also get the evidence toggle and origin tags; the second-step rows are all rendered (inside the closed disclosure) rather than lazily on open.
alternatives: render second-step rows only once the disclosure is opened

behavior_changes.description: Second-step rows name the relationship with the lowercased label ('Client imports Server', 'wiki links'), and a module import with a count but no evidence lines shows the count ('7 imports') as muted text at the row end.
